def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Color 9 forms full separator lines; tile the motif from the occupied cell.
    rs = [r for r in range(n) if all(v == 9 for v in grid[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(m) if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(n))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [n]
    cb = [-1] + cs + [m]
    regions = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
               for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
    # Find the region with the most non-background cells, retaining coordinates
    # relative to the upper-left corner of that region.
    def cells(box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        return [(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] != 7]
    motif = max((cells(b) for b in regions), key=len)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        for dr,dc,v in motif:
            if r0+dr<r1 and c0+dc<c1:
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=v
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep_color=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row))
    rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==sep_color for x in row)]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==sep_color for r in range(h))]
    rs=[-1]+rows+[h]; cs=[-1]+cols+[w]
    boxes=[(rs[i]+1,rs[i+1],cs[j]+1,cs[j+1]) for i in range(len(rs)-1) for j in range(len(cs)-1)]
    def score(b):
        a,z,c,d=b
        return sum(grid[r][q]!=1 and grid[r][q]!=sep_color for r in range(a,z) for q in range(c,d))
    src=max(boxes,key=score); a,z,c,d=src; ph,pw=z-a,d-c
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for q in range(w):
        if r in rows or q in cols: continue
        out[r][q]=grid[a+(r-a)%ph][c+(q-c)%pw]
    return out
PY

    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Color 9 forms full separator lines; tile the motif from the occupied cell.
    rs = [r for r in range(n) if all(v == 9 for v in grid[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(m) if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(n))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [n]

    regions = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
               for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
    # Find the region with the most non-background cells, retaining coordinates
    # relative to the upper-left corner of that region.
    def cells(box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        return [(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] != 7]
    motif = max((cells(b) for b in regions), key=len)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        for dr,dc,v in motif:
            if r0+dr<r1 and c0+dc<c1:
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=v
